Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

translations.web: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
translations.bsb: Do not be afraid when a man grows rich, when the splendor of his house increases.
translations.kjv: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
translations.asv: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, When the glory of his house is increased.
